scope: CPU diagnostic-image publication and row extraction; existing framebuffer pixels and queue ownership preserved. No Rust, emulator or product build in this subtask.

motivation.diagnosis: The previous CPU writer performed 921600 per-pixel writes plus header before queue submission. A separate runtime capture trigger/harness polling race is being repaired by the parent; this C change alone does not prove that race resolved.
motivation.observed: Both applications returned cleanly; first Java UI session had no copied PPM, so overall attempted_render_unconfirmed is preserved. Portrait GPU captures were complete/nonuniform in that run.

implementation.source: CPU-owned physical RGBA linear framebuffer shadow, after successful nwindowQueueBuffer; queued block-linear GPU buffer remains untouched.
implementation.timing: Synchronous diagnostic I/O follows queue submission; no asynchronous writer or latency claim.
implementation.publish: Shared checked PPM publisher writes header and rows to .ppm.tmp, requires successful close, then renames to final .ppm. Failures leave prior complete final and attempt temp cleanup.
implementation.cpu_row_validation: Reject null pointers, empty/oversized dimensions, out-of-range row, short stride/input/output and overflow before reading or writing pixels. Preserve actual RGB order, exclude alpha/stride padding.
implementation.diagnostic_failure: Actual status is logged as cpu_capture_publish_result. Image I/O failure does not convert an already queued frame into an APK execution failure.

coverage: All1280x720 RGB output pixels independently checked in all4 rotated CPU frames with padded stride.
Alpha excluded; output row trailing guard bytes untouched.
Twelve malformed metadata/buffer cases reject before touching output.
Shared publisher exercises actual-file partial header/row writes, row failure, close/rename/open failure, prior-final preservation, temp cleanup and complete stdio publication.

whitespace: git diff --check passed before receipt/documentation update; final check follows.
emulator: not_run_for_this_C_change; parent owns next binary/hash-bound E2E
